doClaim: Ranks and guidance are verified to the 2026-08-14 frozen source packet. The Niantic Game Master inside that packet is dated 2026-04-17: its upstream mirror has not published since, so anything added to the game after that date is not modelled here, except 7 charged moves filled from the WatWowMap masterfile (see honesty.supplementedMoves).
doNotClaim: Fairy has only eight qualifying released Shadow attackers; empty slots are not Pokémon recommendations. PvP rank-1 stat product is not guaranteed matchup-optimal. Stagger timing is not guaranteed. The gym defender ranking is computed over every eligible form and includes the defender's own charged-move offence, but does not model motivation decay, berries, dodging, or an attacker simply bringing the hard counter. Curated placement notes on 12 of those rows are editorial judgment annotating the ranking, not deciding it. The anti-<type> bands floor out low-scoring, doubly-weak technical resistors (see each band's floorNote) rather than listing every form that merely resists the type, so a handful of literal resistors are absent on purpose. Shadow forms are ranked in a separate list with its own 1..N ranks, not merged into the main ranking or excluded from it: a caught shadow fights on Frustration by default and takes 20% more damage, so its rank answers a different question (what can this specific caught Pokémon hold a gym with) than the main list (what should I go build).
